name: Suisei Ginka
source:
Ten years ago, there was an accident during the transport of chemicals in the port city of Mizuho, as well as a series of murders, but it is now just a part of history. At that time, Izana suddenly became separated from her best friend Tetsuo, and she never could come to terms with his disappearance.

This summer Tetsuo suddenly reappeared before the overjoyed Izana. However, he revealed to her a terrible truth…

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/02/01/february-2017-eroge-releases//]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
十年前，港口城市瑞穗发生了化学品运输事故，以及一系列谋杀案，但如今这只是历史的一部分。那时，伊扎娜突然与她最好的朋友哲夫分开了，她永远无法接受他的失踪。

今年夏天，铁雄突然出现在欣喜若狂的伊邪那面前。然而，他却向她透露了一个可怕的真相……

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/02/01/february-2017-eroge-releases//]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
